sources.title: Learn EVERY Flute Fingering from a Pro Flutist
sources.why: Every note demonstrated in turn on a fixed close shot of both hands: the densest fingering-to-pitch source found.
sources.notes: 37 minutes; the first twenty cover the first two octaves, which is the fingering range this model targets.

sources.title: How to Play ALL THE NOTES On the Flute (Fingerings + Timestamps)
sources.why: The same every-note format from a second player and camera, so the fingering model has a held-out player.

sources.title: Try My Flute Warm Up in G Major
sources.why: Long tones, scales, thirds and arpeggios played continuously: many notes, little talk, same player as the fingering video.

sources.title: Flute Scale Practice to IMPROVE your Tone and Technique
sources.why: A chromatic scale chapter: every semitone in order, the fingering model's whole vocabulary in one pass.

sources.title: Flute WARM-UP Play-Along - Scales (Concone Op.11)
sources.why: A play-along with no talk: continuous solo flute for the pitch labeller, a fourth player.
sources.notes: Framing not verifiable from metadata; kept only if the hand-detection rate is usable.

sources.title: Flute Practice With Me - Standard of Excellence Bk1 Pg 5
sources.why: A beginner practising first notes at home: a non-professional hand and an amateur camera, the case an air flautist is.
sources.notes: Framing not verifiable from metadata; kept only if the hand-detection rate is usable.

sources.title: Flute Embouchure Explained - The Band Face Hack
sources.why: A close-up on the mouth while shaping an embouchure on the headjoint: the embouchure half's clearest footage, no fingering.
sources.notes: 720p, 24 fps; face stream is the point, the hand stream is incidental.
